defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Light Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

defensiveAbilities.name: Send Signal
defensiveAbilities.description: The eyelet sends an emergency signal through its scrying sensor to a linked scrying station (see Witness) up to 10 miles away. This transmits the eyelet's distance and direction from the station at the time of sending.

defensiveAbilities.name: Witness
defensiveAbilities.description: The eyelet records whatever it perceives, storing it in an embedded, marble-sized sensor. The eyelet can record up to 1 hour of events, starting and stopping across a longer period. Removing the sensor erases its records. An eyelet can transfer everything it has recorded up to 10 miles to its linked scrying station, where the recordings are collected and can be viewed. Doing so empties the sensor so it can be used again. An eyelet can link, or sever its link, to a scrying station as a 10-minute activity with the concentrate trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Cyclone
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails this save is Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unnerving Observation
offensiveAbilities.description: The eyelets focus their sensors on the same target. One enemy in the swarm's space takes 6d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Will Saving Throw save). On a failed save, the target is Frightened 2 (or Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round on a critical failure).
